import BanditRLProof.OnlineStrongConvexSupport

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2

noncomputable section
open Set
namespace BanditRL.OnlineConvex

theorem stronglyConvex_sourceSubgradient_growth {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (d : ℕ) (e : E ≃ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (f : E → EReal) (V : Set E) (lam : ℝ)
    (hf : SourceProper f) (hV : Convex ℝ V)
    (hdom : V ⊆ effectiveDomain f) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hstrong : ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a < 1 →
      f (a • x + (1 - a) • y) ≤
        (a : EReal) * f x + ((1 - a : ℝ) : EReal) * f y -
          (((lam / 2) * a * (1 - a) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : EReal))
    (p : E) (hp : p ∈ V) (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))
    (hg : g ∈ SourceSubdifferential (fun u => f (e.symm u)) (e p))
    (q : E) (hq : q ∈ V) :
    (f p).toReal + inner ℝ g (e (q - p)) +
      (lam / 2) * ‖q - p‖ ^ 2 ≤ (f q).toReal

end BanditRL.OnlineConvex

binder_ledger.expanded: Arbitrary chosen norm on real vector carrier with algebraic coordinate bijection to R^d; not an isometry. Finite dimensionality and continuity derived internally.
Extended objective, literal feasible set, real modulus, feasible endpoints and coordinate vector.
Forall x f(x)!=bottom and exists x r:real f(x)=coe r.
Forall x in V f(x)<top; together with hf justifies finite toReal.
Exact full header interpolation for all x,y in V, all0<a<1; penalty lam/2*a*(1-a)*norm_E(x-y)^2.
Forall u:R^d, f(e inverse(e p))+coe inner(g,u-e p)<=f(e inverse u). Global support, not just feasible u.

source_delta: This is the generalized forward implication of Lemma4.2 for one supplied global vector support at p, not the full iff. The printed full lemma assumes V subset dom(partial f); existence of support at every V point is neither assumed nor produced here. Coordinates supply the Euclidean pairing only; e is algebraic and the penalty uses the original E norm. No isometry, minimizer, continuity, or extra finite-dimensionality premise is added.
source_proof_spine: Support based at p evaluated at p+a(q-p) -> Definition4.1 interpolation -> divide by a>0 -> a down to zero. Converse/support existence and equality typo excluded OPEN.
implementation_proof_spine: The coordinate equivalence derives finite dimensionality of E. Compose the algebraic real inner-product functional g with e; finite-dimensional continuity promotes this map to a continuous real linear functional L(z)=<g,e(z)>. Evaluate the supplied GLOBAL coordinate subgradient at e(z), simplify e inverse(e(z)), and restrict the resulting support to z in V. Apply stronglyConvex_support_growth to the original f,V,lambda,p,q and this internally obtained L, preserving the exact lambda/2 and E norm. Its existing proof uses an affine tilt and minimum growth. Separately, the printed Lemma4.2 forward proof bases the support at p, evaluates it at p+a(q-p), combines with strong interpolation, divides by positive a, and takes a down to zero. The source limit route is distinct from this implementation reuse route.
